acceptance: morize-core exports ScopeKind from one new scope module with exactly Run, Session, Agent, Project, User, Team, Organization, and Reference as the current baseline variants.
ScopeKind is marked non_exhaustive because docs/DATA_MODEL.md calls these initial kinds and MZ-AUTH-002 requires at least the documented scope families; the current implementation adds no ninth kind.
Every current ScopeKind variant is fieldless, and Reference defines no public-access, inheritance, visibility, or authorization behavior.
ScopeKind supports Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, and Hash; focused tests exercise all eight variants and confirm distinct value semantics without defining an ordering contract.

The implementation defines no Scope struct, ScopeId composition, parent relation, hierarchy, inheritance, policy attachment, Display, FromStr, serde integration, numeric repr/discriminants, public-access behavior, or wire/persistence format.
cargo fmt --all -- --check passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo test --workspace --all-targets --offline passes and includes focused tests for all eight scope kinds and required value semantics.
Cargo manifests and Cargo.lock are unchanged; the Grain admits no runtime, build, or test dependency.
GitHub Actions passes Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows on the exact implementation head before acceptance.

An independent semantic reviewer reviews the exact implementation head for baseline-kind fidelity, non-exhaustive extensibility, Reference non-publicness, absence of hierarchy/authorization/wire semantics, scope containment, and required evidence.
ADR-0004 proof prerequisite for SG-000011 revalidates against the exact WorkPacket baseline before execution.
The implementation changes no path outside crates/morize-core/src/scope.rs and crates/morize-core/src/lib.rs.

method.control: Implementation is limited to one dependency-free non-exhaustive in-memory scope-kind enum, focused tests, and morize-core re-exports. No Scope struct, parent relation, inheritance, visibility, policy attachment, public-access meaning, serialization, persistence, or third-party dependency is authorized.
method.review_separation: An independent semantic reviewer must review the exact implementation head, baseline-kind fidelity, non-exhaustive extensibility, Reference non-publicness, absence of hierarchy/authorization semantics, scope containment, and required evidence separately from the implementing agent before acceptance.
method.rollback: Revert the scope-kind implementation commits; no persisted format, policy attachment, authorization rule, hierarchy, or user data depends on this Grain.

minimality.rationale: A single standard-library-only non-exhaustive enum inside existing morize-core is the narrowest implementation of the already-documented initial scope-kind vocabulary. It preserves future extension while deferring Scope identity composition, hierarchy, policy, authorization, serialization, and persistence.

requirements: Reference must remain a fieldless classification only and must not imply public visibility, anonymous access, inheritance, or authorization behavior in this Grain.

outcome: morize-core exposes one dependency-free non-exhaustive ScopeKind enum covering the eight initial scope kinds already fixed by docs/DATA_MODEL.md, without defining scope hierarchy, inheritance, visibility, policy attachment, persistence, transport, or public-access semantics.
rationale: P1 requires scope identities, docs/DATA_MODEL.md fixes the initial scope-kind vocabulary, and MZ-AUTH-002 requires at least these scope families. This Grain adds only the typed in-memory kind vocabulary so later Scope identity/policy contracts can build on one definition without inventing hierarchy or authorization behavior.

risk.recovery: Revert the scope-kind implementation commits; no persisted format, policy attachment, authorization rule, hierarchy, or user data has been written by this Grain.

scope_in: Define public non-exhaustive ScopeKind with exactly the eight initial kinds fixed by docs/DATA_MODEL.md: Run, Session, Agent, Project, User, Team, Organization, and Reference.

Keep every current scope kind fieldless and derive only Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, and Hash so the vocabulary is typed without defining hierarchy, ordering, visibility, policy, textual, numeric, transport, or persistence semantics.
Document that Reference is the initial reference scope kind only; it does not itself imply public visibility, anonymous access, inheritance, or authorization in this Grain.
Add standard-library-only focused tests that exercise all eight current variants, prove they are distinct hashable values, and prove Copy behavior without textual or numeric encoding.
scope_out: A concrete Scope struct, ScopeId composition, parent/child relations, hierarchy, inheritance, visibility, policy attachment, principal binding, authorization checks, public-access rules, or cross-scope disclosure behavior.
Display/FromStr, serde or other serialization integration, numeric repr/discriminants, persisted or wire encoding, configuration formats, migrations, storage, retrieval, or domain-record integration.
Any third-party runtime, build, or test dependency.
